evidenceRule: Only executed evidence can verify the exact function and environment it observed. Local synthetic fixtures never verify Entra, PHS, Azure Local, OT, or organizational recovery.
authorityDirection: edge.from exercises edge.permission over edge.to using edge.credential; edge.revocation names the actor and mechanism that can remove that authority
recoveryDirection: edge.from depends on edge.to for recovery; recoveryGraph.rejectedEdgeIds excludes illustrated rejected/bootstrap-cycle edges from the selected graph; independent anchors and remaining dependencies are explicit
controlIds: N-01 through N-26; all appear exactly once per case with distinct rationale and requiredEvidence

assessmentIntegration.rule: build.mjs calls the final peer assess(input) directly. Output is an exact engine object, not a bucket-local topology score. All three examples remain insufficient-evidence.

regenerationRule: Generating reader data changes its hash. Rerun the bounded browser check afterward; the final validator rejects stale reader, canonical, engine or SVG observations. No browser/package is installed automatically.

pureLocalApis.validation: scripts/validate.mjs exports validateSchema, validateCase, validateDiagram, stronglyConnectedCycles, reachable, validateAll
pureLocalApis.simulation: scripts/local-models.mjs exports LocalSiteFixture, AcquisitionFixture and runSyntheticChecks; no network/process/filesystem import
pureLocalApis.execution: scripts/record-local-validation.mjs runs owned tests/model checks and writes exact expected/observed local evidence only
pureLocalApis.generation: scripts/build.mjs enriches source/assessment snapshots and generates embedded-data reader plus six Excalidraw/SVG pairs

authorization: Explicit local-only fixtures/browser tests approved; all operational Entra/AD/PHS/OT scope remains blocked. Never infer live approval from this contract or an available credential.
